services.title: Accounting & bookkeeping
services.text: Bookkeeping, account reconciliations and financial reporting to support management decisions and tax preparation.

services.title: Zoho Books & e-invoicing readiness
services.text: As a Zoho partner, PLS supports accounting setup, data migration, invoicing workflows and UAE e-invoicing readiness, including coordination with an Accredited Service Provider where required.

services.title: VAT advisory & compliance
services.text: VAT registration and return filing support, plus invoice and transaction reviews that explain the treatment, supporting evidence and next steps.

services.title: Corporate Tax advisory & filing
services.text: Corporate Tax registration, review of accounting records and tax adjustments, return preparation and filing support, with advice on your business’s specific questions.

services.title: Financial advisory
services.text: Budgeting and forecasting support to help you consider your plans alongside the financial information available.

services.title: Business consulting
services.text: Practical discussions about business operations, plans and the information needed for informed decisions.

faq.question: Where is PLS Accounting based?
faq.answer: PLS Accounting is based at Al Musalla Tower, Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Business hours are Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM, Dubai time. Enquiries are welcome in English or Arabic.

faq.question: What services does PLS Accounting provide?
faq.answer: PLS Accounting, Prime Ledger Solution for Accounting Services, provides accounting and bookkeeping, VAT and Corporate Tax support, Zoho Books implementation, financial advisory and business consulting. The engagement scope identifies the services, responsible adviser and any required representation arrangements.

faq.question: Is PLS a Zoho partner?
faq.answer: Yes. PLS is a Zoho partner and supports Zoho Books implementation and accounting workflows. E-invoicing readiness work includes reviewing data and processes and coordinating with an Accredited Service Provider where required.

faq.question: Who provides specialist tax advice?
faq.answer: Dr. Ahmad Helwani provides specialist VAT and Corporate Tax advice. His UAE Taxes website explains these services. He is an FTA Tax Agent with Bonnard Lawson Dubai; formal representation is confirmed in the engagement and appointment arrangements.

faq.question: What should I prepare before making an enquiry?
faq.answer: Share your business activity, the service or question involved, the relevant period and any approaching deadline. Explain which accounts, invoices or other supporting records are available. You can make an enquiry before every document has been gathered.

faq.question: What does Dr. Ahmad Helwani’s VAT review include?
faq.answer: You receive a written explanation of the issue reviewed, any unresolved information gaps and the recommended next steps. The scope of Dr. Ahmad Helwani’s VAT review is discussed using the transaction details and available supporting records.

faq.question: How can I contact PLS Accounting?
faq.answer: Call +971 58 595 1040 or email ah@pls-uae.com with a short description of your business question. Our business hours are Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM, Dubai time. Enquiries can be made in English or Arabic.
